name: io.github.munhq/chat-recall
description: Shared team knowledge, leaked-secret alerts, ranked code findings and tracked tasks, across every AI coding tool you use

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Server to sync to. Defaults to the hosted service at https://chatrecall.dev; set it to your own instance to self-host. Self-hosting is free for one person.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools to register: "lean" (default, 27 tools — tool choice degrades as the list grows) or "full" (all 61 tools, plus recall_help — a directory of the rest; 4 code-intelligence tools register only with the codeindex companion on PATH). Every tool works when called by name either way.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_NO_DAEMON
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to load the whole server inside each session. By default every session with the same profile and server shares one background daemon, and each session is a thin relay onto it — the engine is loaded once per machine instead of once per session. Turn it off for a sandbox with no writable runtime directory.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_DAEMON_IDLE_SECS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds with no session attached before the shared daemon exits and returns its memory. Default 900. Set 0 to keep it resident.

title: chat-recall
